subject: Finalized: two-track virtual loop + debrief ownership

Subject: Virtual onsite options for Redwood — two-track (engineering + system design)

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for your time on the initial call. We'd like to run a two-track virtual onsite next week: a focused individual contributor engineering track (3 interviews) and a separate systems-design deep dive (2 interviews + short architecture whiteboard). Total candidate-facing time ~2.5 hours, split across a morning and afternoon block so we can include a 30-minute debrief between tracks.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A: Wed 9:00–11:45 (morning track), 13:15–14:45 (design)
- Option B: Thu 10:00–12:30, 14:00–15:30

We will sequence interviews so the engineering interviews happen first (algorithm -> backend -> infra), then a 30-min buffer and the systems-design panel. Rafael will own the debrief for day 1 and Neha will take the final hiring decision debrief.

Attachments: candidate-resume-emma-cho.pdf (resume)

Can you confirm which option you prefer and any constraints (calendar conflicts, timezone issues, or Zoom preferences)? We can also accommodate a single-day compressed schedule if you prefer tighter slots.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Marissa and Emma. Confirming Option B (Thu). I put together a short runbook for the two-track flow and added a compacting plan in case an interviewer drops or candidate needs to shift between slots. Highlights: 

- Morning: 10:00–11:15 — two 35-min engineering interviews (algo, backend). We’ll run a condensed infra bar-check as a 20-min follow-up if needed.
- Lunch buffer / sync: 11:15–12:15 — interviewer break + initial notes in shared doc.
- Afternoon: 14:00–15:30 — systems-design (30-min whiteboard + 30-min panel Q&A).
- Debrief: 15:30–16:00 — Rafael (day-level), 16:00–16:30 — Neha (final hire recommendation).

Please note sequencing constraints: Laura, can you swap with your 14:00 slot to lead the design panel? If any panelist is remote and double-booked, we will fallback to the interviewops standby (InterviewOps) or move the whiteboard to an asynchronous artifact (draw.io link).

I attached panel-runbook-v2.pdf and added a HubSpot link to the candidate record. Marissa — can you send calendar invites with the 10-min pre-call briefing for interviewers (15 mins before first interview) and include the candidate Zoom link?

Rafael
Director, Engineering Recruiting (acting)
